title: 1743. Restore the Array From Adjacent Pairs

examples.explanation: This array has all its adjacent pairs in adjacentPairs. Notice that adjacentPairs[i] may not be in left-to-right order.
There can be negative numbers. Another solution is [-3,1,4,-2], which would also be accepted.
